_comment: Single source of truth for the vault slug and for every vault-owned skill/agent/plugin name. Pattern: <verb>-<slug>-vault (verb first). Read by kit-rename.py (migration of old installs), by the site tooling (netlify-site/vault_config.py: docs, build checks) and by tests. A future topic vault changes 'slug' here and runs netlify-site/tools/vault_rename.py retag. Entries in 'renamed' are the PREVIOUS names; the migration removes them from user machines. Entries in 'removed' are skills/agents that were MERGED into the item named in 'into'; the same migration removes unchanged copies (edited or user-owned ones stay, with a warning). Tool file names under claude-kit/tools (vault-find.py, kbq.py, ...) are namespaced by the claude-kit folder and keep their names.
